steps.en: Clone the repo on an Apple Silicon Mac and run its setup script
steps.zh: 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上克隆仓库，跑它的安装脚本

steps.en: Reads your RAM, picks a model that fits, installs mlx-lm in a venv and downloads the weights
steps.zh: 读内存大小，挑一个装得下的模型，在虚拟环境装 mlx-lm 并下载权重

steps.en: Links its server into place and puts a Claude Local launcher on your Desktop
steps.zh: 把服务器脚本链接到位，在桌面放一个 Claude Local 启动器

steps.en: Starts the MLX server on localhost:4000 and opens Claude Code pointed at it
steps.zh: 在 4000 端口起 MLX 服务器，打开连向它的 Claude Code

steps.en: Work in Claude Code as usual
steps.zh: 照常在 Claude Code 里干活

steps.en: Answers each turn on the Mac's GPU and turns the model's tool-call text into Claude Code tool calls
steps.zh: 在 GPU 上回答每一轮，把模型的工具调用文本转成 Claude Code 调用

value.en: Claude Code keeps working with no cloud model, no API key and no usage limit — prompts and code stay on the Mac
value.zh: Claude Code 不靠云端模型、不要 API key、不受额度限制照样能用，提示词和代码都留在本机

sources: https://github.com/nicedreamzapp/claude-code-local README 'Get started' (git clone …; cd claude-code-local; bash setup.sh; Claude Local.command on the Desktop; double-click it)

install.sh (clones to ~/claude-code-local, exec bash setup.sh); setup.sh (RAM tiers → MODEL_ID, pip install mlx-lm into ~/.local/mlx-server, mlx_lm load() download, ln -sf proxy/server.py, writes ~/Desktop/Claude Local.command)
launchers/Claude Local.command + launchers/lib/claude-local-common.sh (ensure_mlx_server on :4000, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000 claude ...)
proxy/server.py docstring and do_POST (/v1/messages; Gemma 4 / Llama JSON / HF <tool_call> formats converted to Anthropic tool_use; HTTPServer on 127.0.0.1)
